from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import base64, hashlib, json, zlib

TASK="A2Z-V4-SOL-BUILD-20261007-R4"
CAMPAIGN=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
REQ=CAMPAIGN/"requests"/(TASK+".json")

if not REQ.is_file():
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=REQUEST_MISSING", flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(31)

try:
    obj=json.loads(REQ.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
except Exception as exc:
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=INVALID_JSON:"+type(exc).__name__, flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(32)

if obj.get("task_id") != TASK:
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=TASK_MISMATCH", flush=True); raise SystemExit(33)
if obj.get("phase") != "SOL_BUILD":
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=PHASE_MISMATCH", flush=True); raise SystemExit(34)
for key in ("live_trading","paid_actions","wallet_actions"):
    if obj.get(key) is not False:
        print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=UNSAFE_"+key.upper(), flush=True); raise SystemExit(35)
prompt=obj.get("prompt")
if not isinstance(prompt,str) or not prompt.strip():
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=PROMPT_MISSING", flush=True); raise SystemExit(36)
if len(prompt)>100000:
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=PROMPT_TOO_LARGE", flush=True); raise SystemExit(37)
need=[
 "You are exactly GPT-5.6 Sol.",
 "A2Z-V4-ASTRA-POSTBUILD-20261006-R3-P2",
 "AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d",
 "Do not execute code, tests, imports, measurements, tools, network calls, trades, paid actions or wallet actions.",
]
missing=[x for x in need if x not in prompt]
if missing:
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=BINDING_MARKERS_MISSING count="+str(len(missing)), flush=True); raise SystemExit(38)

raw=json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
packed=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(zlib.compress(raw,9)).decode("ascii")
prompt_sha=hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
request_sha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=PASS", flush=True)
print("PROMPT_CHARS="+str(len(prompt)), flush=True)
print("PROMPT_SHA256="+prompt_sha, flush=True)
print("REQUEST_SHA256="+request_sha, flush=True)
print("COMPRESSED_CHARS="+str(len(packed)), flush=True)

# Existing external-continuation context limit is 6000 chars. Reserve metadata overhead.
if len(packed)>5200:
    print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=NEEDS_CHUNKING", flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(20)
print("R4_DIRECT_INPUT=FITS_SINGLE_CONTEXT", flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0)
